requirements.requirement: Identity or receptor expression describes a useful product attribute but does not by itself establish tested biological function.
A product-relevant activity comparison needs defined product-plus-target and target-only conditions, background and response controls.
A surrogate measurement needs evidence linking it to the relevant biological activity; quantity or expression alone does not supply that link.
Controlled activity does not establish tissue access, safety, persistence or patient benefit; those need relevant evidence.
Potency interpretation and release criteria are product-specific, under stated conditions and references, with no universal passing cutoff implied.
In the fictional high-viability/receptor-positive lot, passing identity and viability cannot cancel a failed product-relevant activity criterion or authorize administration.

The linked fictional two-hour example keeps 100 target events per condition and effectors outside the denominator: 40% minus 30% is 10 percentage points associated excess, not normalized lysis, individual-death causality or a patient-response prediction.
Name the old and new process and properties affected by the change; a shared product or process name is not the comparison.
Where suitable, divide the same cellular starting material across old and new processes to reduce input variation without claiming all uncertainty is removed.
Compare identity, composition, biological activity, impurities and stability with methods and criteria appropriate to the attributes at risk.
Passing routine release specifications alone does not establish full manufacturing comparability; broader sensitive characterization may be needed.
The bridge to earlier quality, safety and efficacy evidence is conditional; unresolved differences can require additional nonclinical or clinical evidence.
Comparability does not demand numeric identity and is not head-to-head clinical equivalence, statistical nonsignificance alone or automatic authorization.
In the fictional medium-change example, similar final cell counts do not settle a changed relevant T-cell subset or the relevance of earlier evidence.
In the illustrated conventional approach the peptide carboxyl end stays resin-tethered while extension proceeds toward the amino end.
Remove temporary terminal protection before coupling the next protected amino-acid unit; linked units are added in a controlled chemical cycle.
Washing removes soluble material while the resin tether remains; it does not repair an incorrect or incompletely reacted chain.
Repeat removal, coupling and washing without inferring complete coupling, yield, universal timing or an executable synthesis recipe from the schematic.
Cleavage from resin and remaining protecting-group removal are separate from purification, identity/quality testing and final product release.
Sequence-dependent chain association can obstruct reactions; a tested backbone-protection approach does not make all sequences equally easy.

A rapid fictional synthesis with multiple chromatographic components and a correct-mass fraction does not establish a ready-to-administer vaccine, useful immune recognition or clinical benefit; assay peptide, crude material and finished product are separate.

nonCanonicalChecks.requirement: Schematic colours, vial/bead shapes, ordinal panels and fictional glyph/bar quantities do not identify atomic structures, actual lots, biological scale or clinical outcomes.
Historical PASS, authorship, source/pixel-reading, model-call, contrast, keyboard/focus and private capture claims remain documentary assertions, not fresh independent or expert acceptance.
The 2011 potency and 2023 draft references are assessed at their stated historical source-check date; current final-guidance status needs raw verification rather than a stale landing-page label.
Pinned source/owner/brief/output hash relationships are checked separately from historical preimages, unretained code and unavailable commit claims.
Fresh full native comparisons record the comparability vial/subtitle contact and the symbolic SPPS wash-arrow ambiguity, without site/browser, physical-device or accessibility approval.
The existing linked cytotoxicity example retains its own owner and asset role; the potency addition is a product-quality distinction rather than a replacement assay or extra study result.
